evidence.summary: Exhaustive sweep of every finite FP16 value (63,488) plus edge sizes 1/4093/131072: max abs error vs FP64 erfc reference is 5.27e-7 at x=0.91064453125, with 0 violations of the 1e-6 tolerance. The A&S approximation stays within the contract tolerance across the whole legal domain.

rationale: The A&S 7.1.26 formula has |error| up to ~7.5e-8 in Phi with full-precision coefficients; truncating to 6 digits and composing with x could push error above 1e-6 in the intermediate range, especially for moderate negative x where |x|·eps(Phi) matters.
